readme.run: Fit the diffusion tensor inside a MindGrab brain mask
notes: Runs the web app's tensor fit (niimath --dtifit, same WebAssembly build) and
writes FA, MD, L1-L3, V1-V3, S0, MO, the tensor and the brain mask.
MindGrab runs on the CPU and needs about 3 GB of memory. Give --mask FILE
to use your own brain mask, or --no-mask to fit every voxel.
Tractography is not included: it needs WebGPU with subgroups. Use the web app.
No network connection is required. Input is NIfTI with FSL bval/bvec files.
Please cite: Basser PJ, Mattiello J, LeBihan D. MR diffusion tensor
